findings.label: Mapping test no longer verifies attribute round-trip
findings.detail: fallback_catalog_has_expected_models_and_metadata checks id/owned_by per index but no longer asserts context_window, supports_vision, or max_completion_tokens are mapped from the const into the Model. Consider per-index equality against NVIDIA_NIM_FALLBACK_MODELS[i] for these fields to restore mapping-correctness coverage without reintroducing value-locking.
